title: Sky Drifters Hot Air Ballooning
specs: Flights at sunrise or an hour before sunset when winds are calm
Pilots hold FAA commercial licenses and balloons are FAA certified
All clients must call the office between 10:00am and 6:00pm the day before the flight to confirm weather and meeting time
Single passengers must book a date with other passengers; no single riders at shared basket rates
Tethered balloon rides can take over 70 people in about two hours

blurb: Guests fly in hot air balloons over the Sacramento Valley, enjoying scenic views at sunrise or an hour before sunset when winds are calm. Flights include watching the balloon being assembled and inflated, and a celebration with champagne after landing for proposal flights. They also offer balloon rentals for TV, film, special events, and advertising.
